* S.L.L. (Sociedad Limitada Laboral): a labour limited corporation
* S.C. (Sociedad Colectiva): roughly a [[general partnership]]
* S.C.P. (Sociedad Civil Privada): ¿?
* S.Cra. (Sociedad Comanditaria): roughly a [[limited partnership]]
** S.Com. p. A. (Sociedad Comanditaria por Acciones)
** S.Com p.A.P. (Sociedad Comanditaria por Acciones Profesional)
* S.Coop. (Sociedad Cooperativa): a [[cooperative]] that typically is owned and democratically controlled by its workers

===Sweden===
* [[Aktiebolag]] – AB: a private limited company ≈ [[Limited company|Ltd.]] (UK). The minimum capital is [[Swedish krona|SEK]]&nbsp;25,000.
* Publikt aktiebolag – AB (publ): public limited company ≈ [[public limited company|plc]] (UK). The minimum capital is SEK&nbsp;500,000.
** Bankaktiebolag: joint-stock bank company
** Försäkringsaktiebolag: joint-stock insurance company
** Tjänstepensionsaktiebolag: joint-stock occupational pension company
* Ekonomisk förening – Ek. för.: economic association (minimum three members) ≈ [[cooperative]]
** Bostadsrättsförening: condominium/home-owners' association
** Kooperativ hyresrättsförening: home-renters' association
** Bostadsförening: apartment-owners' association (established before 1930)
** Sambruksförening: cooperative farming or gardening association
** Försäkringsförening: insurance association
* Enskild näringsidkare (a.k.a. enskild firma): [[sole proprietorship|sole trader]]
* Handelsbolag – HB: [[general partnership|trading partnership]]
* Kommanditbolag – KB: [[limited partnership]]
* Enkelt bolag: regulated partnership between two parts (companies or private persons)
* Ideell förening: [[non-profit organisation]]
* Samfällighetsförening: community association
* Stiftelse: [[foundation (nonprofit organization)|foundation]], comparable to German [[Stiftung]]
* Trossamfund: religious organisation
* Filial: foreign branch
** Bankfilial: foreign bank branch
** Försäkringsfilial: foreign insurance branch
* Sparbank: savings bank
* Medlemsbank: credit union
* Ömsesidigt försäkringsbolag: [[mutual insurance]] company
* Ömsesidigt tjänstepensionsbolag: mutual occupational pension company
* Tjänstepensionsförening: occupational pension association<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.bolagsverket.se/foretag.473.html |title=Företag – Bolagsverket |date=13 June 2023}}</ref>

=== Turkey ===
According to Code of Obligations (fifth book of Civil Code) (Act No: 6098):
* Adi ortaklık: ≈ [[Simple partnership]] (has no legal personality)

According to the Commercial Code (Act No: 6102):

Ortaklıklar ≈ [[Partnership]]s (unlike the partnerships in Anglo-American law, they also have legal personality like companies)
* Koll. Şti. (kolektif şirket): ≈ [[General Partnership|Collective partnership]]
* Kom. Şti (komandit şirket): ≈ [[Limited Partnership|Commandite partnership]]: Can be established as simple commandite partnership or as commandite company divided into shares (Sermayesi paylara bölünmüş komandit şirket.).

Sermaye şirketleri ≈ [[Company|Companies]]
* A.Ş. / A.O. ({{Lang|tr|Anonim Şirket / Anonim Ortaklık}}): ≈ [[Joint-stock company]]: Minimum capital is [[Turkish lira|TL]] 250,000. Bearer or registered shares, of a minimum [[par value]] of TL 0.01 each. Only type of company that can be publicly traded in Turkish law.
* Ltd. Şti. / L.Ş. / L.O. (Limited şirket / Limited ortaklık) ≈ [[Limited company]]: Minimum capital is TL 50,000. Registered shares only, of a minimum [[par value]] of TRY 25 each.

According to the Capital Markets Act (Act No: 6362):
* HAAO ({{Lang|tr|Halka Açık Anonim Ortaklık}}) ≈ [[Public company|Publicly held corporation]]: This essentially is a special type of A.O. These types of companies can only be established as A.O.'s. When there are no specific rules under Capital Markets legislation, A.O. rules under Turkish Commercial Code will be applied to HAAO's.

According to the Cooperatives Act (Act No: 1163):
* Koop. (kooperatif şirket) ≈ [[Cooperative]]

Other entitites:
* (irtibat bürosu): ≈ liaison office
* Şahıs şirketi: ≈ [[Sole proprietorship]]
* Şb. (şube): ≈ [[Branch office|Branch Office]]

=== Ukraine ===
* DAT/ДАТ ([[:uk:Державне акціонерне товариство]] /Derzhavne aktsionerne tovarystvo): ≈ [[public limited company|plc]], national
* FOP/ФОП ([[:uk:Фізична особа-підприємець]]/ Fizychna osoba pidpryyemets): [[sole proprietorship]]
* KT/КТ ([[:uk:Командитне товариство]]/ Komandytne tovarystvo): ≈ [[limited partnership]]
* PT/ПT ([[:uk:Повне товариство]]/ Povne tovarystvo): ≈ [[general partnership]]
* TDV/ТДВ ([[:uk:Товариство з додатковою відповідальністю]]/ Tovarystvo z dodatkvoiu vidpovidalnistiu): {{lit.}} "additional liability company"
* TOV/TOB ([[:uk:Товариство з обмеженою відповідальністю]]/ Tovarystvo z obmezhenoiu vidpovidalnistiu): ≈ public [[Limited company|Ltd.]] (UK). No minimum capital.
* PP/ПП ([[:uk:Приватне підприємство]]/ Pryvatne pidpryyemstvo): ≈ private [[Limited company|Ltd.]] (UK). No minimum capital.
* PAT/ПАТ ([[:uk:Публічне акціонерне товариство]]/ Publichne aktsionerne tovarystvo) (before 29.04.2009 – VAT/[[:uk:ВАТ]] (Вiдкрите акцiонерне товариство/ Vidkryte aktsionerne tovarystvo)): ≈ [[public limited company|plc]]. Minimum capital – 1250 minimum wages ([[Hryvnia|UAH]] 7,500,000 as of 27.09.2021).<ref>{{cite web |title=Мінімальні розміри статутних капіталів господарських товариств |url=https://services.dtkt.ua/catalogues/indexes/10 |website=services.dtkt.ua}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Про акціонерні товариства |url=https://zakon.rada.gov.ua/go/514-17 |website=Офіційний вебпортал парламенту України}}</ref>
* PrAT/ПрАТ ([[:uk:Приватне акціонерне товариство]]/ Prytvatne aktsionerne tovarystvo) (before 29.04.2009 – ZAT/[[:uk:ЗАТ]] (Закрите акцiонерне товариство/ Zakryte Aktsionerne Tovarystvo)): ≈ [[public limited company|plc]] (UK), private. Minimum capital – same as PAT.
* AT/АТ ([[:uk:Акціонерне товариство]]/ Aktsionerne tovarystvo): ≈ [[Joint-stock company|JSC]]. Minimum capital – same as PAT.

Company formation is regulated by the Ukrainian Civil Code<ref>{{cite web |title=The Civil Code of Ukraine |url=https://zakon.rada.gov.ua/go/435-15 |website=Official web-portal of the Parliament of Ukraine}}</ref> and Commercial Code,<ref>{{cite web |title=The Commercial Code of Ukraine |url=https://zakon.rada.gov.ua/go/436-15 |website=Official web-portal of the Parliament of Ukraine}}</ref> Law On Business Associations,<ref>{{cite web |title=On Business Associations |url=https://zakon.rada.gov.ua/go/1576-12 |website=Official web-portal of the Parliament of Ukraine}}</ref> Law On Joint Stock Companies,<ref>{{cite web |title=On Joint Stock Companies |url=https://zakon.rada.gov.ua/go/514-17 |website=Official web-portal of the Parliament of Ukraine}}</ref> Law On Limited Liability Companies and Additional Liability Companies.<ref>{{cite web |title=Про товариства з обмеженою та додатковою відповідальністю |url=https://zakon.rada.gov.ua/go/2275-19 |website=Official web-portal of the Parliament of Ukraine}}</ref>

==Mexico==
[[Mexico]]'s General Law of Commercial Companies recognizes, among other forms, the Sociedad Anónima and the Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada, the latter added by 2016 reforms to facilitate single-shareholder startups.<ref>{{Cite web |title=DOF - Diario Oficial de la Federación |url=https://www.dof.gob.mx/nota_detalle.php?codigo=5429707&fecha=14/03/2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250218162931/https://www.dof.gob.mx/nota_detalle.php?codigo=5429707&fecha=14/03/2016 |archive-date=2025-02-18 |access-date=2025-08-30 |website=Dof.gob.mx |language=es}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-05-25 |title=Ley General de Sociedades Mercantiles › Capítulo XIV - De la Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada› Artículos 260 al 273 |url=https://mexico.justia.com/federales/leyes/ley-general-de-sociedades-mercantiles/capitulo-xiv/ |access-date=2025-08-30 |website=Justia |language=es-mx}}</ref>
;Business entities according to the "Ley General de Sociedades Mercantiles" (General Law of Commercial Companies)
* Persona Física
* S.A. ([[Sociedad Anónima]]): ≈ [[public limited company|plc]] (UK)
* S. de R.L.(Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada): ≈ [[Limited company|Ltd.]] (UK)
* Associates name and "y compañía" or Associates name and "y sucesores"(Sociedad en Nombre Colectivo): ≈ [[general partnership]]
* S. en C. (Sociedad en Comandita Simple): ≈ [[limited partnership]]
* S. en C. por A. (Sociedad en Comandita por Acciones): ≈ [[master limited partnership]]

Note: Any of these entities can be incorporated as a "Capital Variable" entity, in which case has to add the "de C.V." sufix to its company name. Example: "S.A. de C.V.", "S. de R.L. de C.V."

;Business entities according to the "Ley del Mercado de Valores" (Stock Market Law)
* S.A.B. (Sociedad Anónima Bursátil)
* S.A.P.I. (Sociedad Anónima Promotora de Inversión)

==Peru==
* [[S.A. (corporation)|S.A.]] (Sociedad Anónima): ≈ [[public limited company|plc]] (UK)
* Sociedad Anónima Abierta (S.A.A.): To qualify to register as an S.A.A., a company must meet one or more conditions laid down in Article 249 of Peru's General Corporation Law. Those conditions state there must be a primary public offering of shares or convertible bonds in stocks, which are held by more than 750 shareholders, more than 35% of its capital belonging to 175 shareholders, or that all shareholders entitled to vote approve the adjustment to the scheme. The S.A.A. is then audited by the Comisión Nacional Supervisora de Empresas y Valores (CONASEV).<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.sni.org.pe/servicios/legal/reportelegal/content/view/2131/30/ |title=Sociedad Anonima Cerrada y Abierta |date=27 July 2007 |access-date=3 November 2011 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110810030349/http://www.sni.org.pe/servicios/legal/reportelegal/content/view/2131/30 |archive-date=10 August 2011}}</ref>
* Sociedad Anónima Cerrada (S.A.C.):<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.limaeasy.com/business-guide/company-and-corporation-types-in-peru#closely-held |title=Company & Corporation Types in Peru – LimaEasy |website=Limaeasy.com |access-date=2019-07-17}}</ref> These companies must have a minimum of 2 and a maximum of 20 shareholders. These shares can't be registered in the Public Registry.

==Philippines==
With the exception of [[Homeowner association|homeowners' associations]] (now regulated<ref name="250317_dhsud_memo">{{cite web|url=https://dhsud.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/Laws_Issuances/03_Advisories/2025/Approved%20Advisory%20on%20the%20Re-registration%20of%20HOAs.pdf|format=PDF|title=Approved Advisory on the Re-registration of HOAs|website=Dhsud.gov.ph|access-date=June 16, 2026}}</ref><ref name="expl8n">{{Cite web|url=https://www.respicio.ph/commentaries/can-an-hoa-collect-dues-without-updated-sec-registration-or-proper-authority|title=Can an HOA Collect Dues Without Updated SEC Registration or Proper Authority?|first=Jelyn|last=Dalanon|date=Feb 15, 2026|website=Respicio.ph|access-date=June 16, 2026}}</ref><ref name="bilyo_dva_legal_personality">{{Cite web|url=https://bilyonaryo.com/2026/03/05/why-risk-our-roads-befuddled-cochingyan-presses-dasma-village-to-approve-by-law-changes/banner-story/|title='Why risk our roads?' 'Befuddled' Cochingyan presses Dasma Village to approve by-law changes - Bilyonaryo Business News|date=Mar 5, 2026|website=Bilyonaryo.com|access-date=June 16, 2026}}</ref> by the [[Department of Human Settlements and Urban Development]] (DHSUD)), the [[Legal personality|legal existence]] (as provided for under Article 44 of the [[Civil Code of the Philippines|Civil Code]]) of all non-government corporate/juridical entities in the [[Philippines]] are contingent on the approval and continuance of registration with either the [[Securities and Exchange Commission (Philippines)|Securities and Exchange Commission]] or the [[Cooperative Development Authority]]. The earlier is for partnerships, corporations / foundations, investment products (such as [[Bond (finance)|bonds]] and [[preferred shares]]), while the latter is for [[cooperatives]].
* '''Corporations:'''
** ''Corporation'' and ''Incorporated'' (may be abbrrviated as ''Corp''. and ''Inc''. respectively): ≈ [[Private company limited by shares|Ltd]] and [[public limited company|plc]] (UK) or [[corporation]] (US) with two or more shareholders and directors.<br><small>(Prior to the enactment of the [https://elibrary.judiciary.gov.ph/thebookshelf/showdocs/2/86463 2019 Revised Corporation Code], minimum number of shareholders were 5)</small>
*** [[Government-owned and controlled corporation]] (GOCC): ≈ [[Statutory corporation#United Kingdom|Statutory corporation]] (UK), [[government-sponsored enterprise|GSE]] and [[State-owned enterprises of the United States|FOE]] (US). Except when legislated otherwise (e.g. [[Government Service Insurance System]] and [[Land Bank of the Philippines]]), GOCCs use the ''Corp.'' and ''Inc.'' suffixes as with other corporations.
*** At least some which were existing and named as such before the rules were promulgated, were allowed to continue without the suffix , e.g. "[[Bank of the Philippine Islands]]", "[[Philippine National Bank]]","[[Union Bank of the Philippines]]".<ref name="bpi26infostmt">{{Cite web|url=https://edge.pse.com.ph/openDiscViewer.do?edge_no=07875cdc9c6bfb9364d70b69f0a3140b|title=Information Statement|website=Edge.pse.com.ph|access-date=June 16, 2026}}</ref>
** One-person corporation (OPC):  ≈ [[Private company limited by shares|Ltd]] and [[public limited company|plc]] (UK) or [[corporation]] (US) with sole shareholder and director. Not analogous to [[limited liability company|LLC]] (US) as OPCs may not avail of [[Flow-through entity|flow-through income taxation]].<ref>{{cite web |title=REPUBLIC ACT No. 11232 An Act Providing for the Revised Corporation Code of the Philippines |url=https://lawphil.net/statutes/repacts/ra2019/ra_11232_2019.html |publisher=The LAWPHiL Project |access-date=16 September 2021}}</ref>
* '''Partnerships:'''
** Company (Co.): ≈ [[General partnership]] (UK, US). Historically also used by corporations and other legal entities, such as the [[Manila Railroad Company]].<ref name="fe">{{Cite magazine |first=George |last=Roa |magazine=The Far-Eastern Review|title=Engineering, Commerce, Finance |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=z-siAQAAMAAJ |volume=3 |date=June 1906 |access-date=2022-04-14}}</ref><ref>{{Cite court |litigants=MURPHY, MORRIS AND CO vs INSULAR COLLECTOR OF CUSTOMS |reporter=G.R. No. L-5022 |url=https://www.lawphil.net/judjuris/juri1910/mar1910/gr_l-5022_1910.html |court=[[Supreme Court of the Philippines]] |date=1910-03-22 |access-date=2022-04-14}}</ref> Existing corporations like [[Manila Broadcasting Company]], [[Meralco]], [[Metrobank (Philippines)|Metrobank]] still retain this older suffix, but new or renamed corporations must now include either ''Corp.'' or ''Inc.'' in their legal name to distinguish them from partnerships. This happened to  the [[PLDT|Philippine Long Distance Telephone ''Company'']] after it decided to instead go for the [[initialism]] of their previous corporate name, ending up as "<code>PLDT Inc.</code>"
** Limited company (Ltd., Ltd. Co.): ≈ [[Limited partnership]] (UK, US). Not to be confused with the obsolete ''private limited company'' below.
** Limited (liability) partnership (LP, LLP): ≈ [[Limited partnership]] and [[limited liability partnership]] (UK, US)
* '''Others:'''
** [[Cooperative]] (Coop.)
** Enterprise (Ent.): Used by some [[sole proprietorship]]s but are not true legal entities.
* '''Obsolete:'''
** ''Compañía'' (Cía): For partnerships and other forms of business during the Spanish rule (e.g. [[Ayala Corporation|Ayala y Compañía]]).
** Private limited company (Ltd., Co. Ltd., or Co., Ltd.): ≈ [[private limited company|Ltd]] (UK), [[limited liability company|LLC]] (US).<ref name="fe"/> Initially used during the early American colonial period, it has since been replaced by Corp. and Inc.
** ''Sociedad anónima'' ([[S.A. (corporation)|SA, S.A.]]): Formed under Spanish rule. Replaced by private limited company.

== Hybrid legal systems (Islamic) ==

=== Saudi Arabia ===
* Private Limited Company ( شركة ذات مسئولية محدودة)
* Joint-Stock company ( شركة مساهمة )
* General Partnership Company ( شركة تضامن )
* Limited Partnership (شركة التوصية البسيطة )
* Foreign Company ( شركة أجنبية )
* Individual Establishment ( مؤسسة فردية )
[[Saudi Arabia]]'s new Companies Law modernized company forms and introduced the Simplified Joint Stock Company to support startups and VC activity.<ref>{{cite web |date=2022 |title=Companies Law (English translation) |url=https://gccbdi.org/sites/default/files/content-files/Resources/Governance%20%26%20Director%20Information/KSA/Company%20Law%202022%20-%20%28English%29.pdf |access-date=30 August 2025 |website=Gulf Cooperation Council Board Directors Institute}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=New Saudi Companies Law 2022: Key Changes, and Next Steps for Companies in KSA |url=https://www.bracewell.com/resources/new-saudi-companies-law-2022-key-changes-and-next-steps-companies-ksa/ |access-date=2025-08-30 |website=Bracewell LLP |language=en-US}}</ref>

=== United Arab Emirates ===
The [[United Arab Emirates|UAE's]] Federal Decree-Law No. 32 of 2021 governs company types. Since 2021 reforms, onshore "mainland" companies in many sectors may be 100% foreign-owned.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Federal Decree by Law No. (32) of 2021 on Commercial Companies |url=https://uaelegislation.gov.ae/en/legislations/1542/download |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241122072714/https://uaelegislation.gov.ae/en/legislations/1542/download |archive-date=2024-11-22 |access-date=2025-08-30 |website=uaelegislation.gov.ae}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Full foreign ownership of commercial companies {{!}} The Official Portal of the UAE Government |url=https://u.ae/en/information-and-services/business/doing-business-on-the-mainland/full-foreign-ownership-of-commercial-companies |access-date=2025-08-30 |website=u.ae |language=en}}</ref>

In UAE [[Free economic zone|Free Zones]], a '''Free Zone Establishment''' (FZE) or Free Zone Company (FZC) is a limited liability company governed by the rules and regulations of the [[List of free economic zones#United Arab Emirates|free zone]] in which it is established.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Establishing business in free zones |url=https://www.moet.gov.ae/en/establishing-business-in-free-zones |access-date=2025-01-28 |website=UAE Ministry of Economy & Tourism}}</ref>

This is a '''list of official business registers''' around the world.<ref name=":0">{{cite web|title=Official company registers|url=http://www.rba.co.uk/sources/registers.htm|access-date=2021-05-29|website=www.rba.co.uk}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=OpenCorporates :: The Open Database Of The Corporate World|url=https://opencorporates.com/registers|access-date=2021-05-29|website=opencorporates.com}}</ref>

There are many types of official [[Company register|business registers]], usually maintained for various purposes by a state authority, such as a government agency, or a [[court of law]]. In some cases, it may also be devolved to [[Self-regulated organization|self-governing]] bodies, either commercial (a [[chamber of commerce]]) or professional (a [[regulatory college]]); or to a dedicated, highly regulated company (i.e., operator of a [[stock exchange]], a [[multilateral trading facility]], a [[central securities depository]] or an [[alternative trading system]]).

The following is an incomplete list of official business registers by country.

{{TOC right|limit=3}}

== Types of registers ==
A business register may include data on entities, as well as on their status for various purposes. Examples of such registers include:

* '''[[company register]]''' — a register of legal entities in the jurisdiction they operate under, for the purpose of establishing, [[Dissolution (law)|dissolving]], [[Business acquisition|acquisition]] of legal capacity and (in some cases) juridical personality, determination of legal representation, protection, accountability, and control of legal entities.
* '''list of undertakings cleared for access to classified information''' — register of companies authorized to work on contracts involving dealing with sensitive information documents of a government or an international organisation, usually maintained by a counter-intelligence service.
* '''[[statistical business register]]''' — plays a central part in a system of official economic statistics at a [[national statistics office]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/ramon/coded_files/RITZEN_Jean_SBR.pdf|title=Statistical Business Register: Content, place and role in Economic Statistics.|last=Ritzen|first=Jean|publisher=Statistics Netherlands|website=ec.europa.eu}}</ref>

Another group of business registers is focused on various [[asset]]s or [[Liability (financial accounting)|liabilities]] of an entity, rather than on entities themselves, these include: 
* '''[[public contract]] register''' — a repository that aims at keeping track of all procurements, usually awarded through a [[Invitation to tender|tender]], concluded by the public institutions, making this information available online, thereby providing a basis for monitoring the way in which public money is spent.
* '''[[public aid]] register''' — an official register of businesses in difficulties which received aid from the state.
* '''[[ultimate beneficial owner]] register''' — an official repository of natural person or persons who ultimately own or control a company, maintained to counteract [[money laundering]] and [[Terrorism financing|terrorist financing]].
* '''[[land registration|land and mortgage register]]''' — concerns titles, rights, and liabilities (such as real estate [[lien]]s or [[Pledge (law)|pledges]]) related to [[real estate]], consisting of premises specified in a cadaster, such as land, buildings, or condominium units,
* '''[[cadaster]]''' — determines the [[geospatial]] [[Localization and internationalization|localization]], the extent, and (in some cases) the value of premises, including [[Land-parcel identification system|land parcels]], buildings, and [[Condominium (living space)|condominium]] units, which together form real estate, subject to rights and liabilities registered in a land and mortgage register,
* '''[[vehicle register]]''' (such as those [[motor vehicle registration|for motor vehicles]], [[rolling stock]], [[ship registration|boat or ships]], or [[aircraft registration|aircraft]]) — includes entries containing data on [[vehicle identification number]], [[vehicle registration plate]] number, [[vehicle title]], [[type approval]], [[vehicle inspection]]s, [[vehicle insurance|liability insurance]], as well as vehicle [[lien]]s, such as [[maritime lien]]s, and which sometimes may be connected to a register of pledges or [[tax lien]]s.
* '''register of [[pledge (law)|pledges]]''' — includes entries concerning liabilities (pledges and voluntary specific liens) of a pledgor to a creditor, secured by tying them to a pledgor's [[Collateral (finance)|collateral]], such as a movable, a [[Security (finance)|security]], or an [[intellectual property right]].
* '''[[industrial property]] register''' — an official database containing registered [[trade mark]]s, as well as [[patent]]ed [[invention]]s, [[industrial design]]s, [[utility model]]s, or [[integrated circuit]]s, thus protecting and reserving the rights of the company which developed them or bought rights to them.
* '''[[plant breeders’ rights]] register''' — registers rights to a [[protected plant]] variety, developed and registered by a [[plant breeder]].

Some types of business registers combine the features of both groups, these include:
* '''tax register''' — a register used for the purpose of revenue collection, including taxes, [[duty (economics)|duties]] such as [[tariffs]] or [[excise]], as well as mandatory [[social insurance]] and [[health insurance]] contributions; such a register includes all taxable entities, as well as their tax liabilities, including [[tax lien]]s.
* '''[[public company]] and [[Security (finance)|securities]] register''' — the official repository of [[publicly listed]] or [[Unlisted public company|unlisted]] companies whose at least one emission of securities was offered for the purpose of [[Free-trading|free trading]] to a number of persons exceeding certain threshold (varying according to jurisdiction), thus placing such a company under specific regulatory obligations, mainly concerning mandatory publication of information on the terms and rights attached to the offered security, as well as information on the company itself and its finances.
* '''list of companies and their securities publicly traded on a stock market''' — maintained by a [[stock exchange]] or an [[alternative trading system]] for the purpose of [[Stock trading|trading]] and [[Stock quote|quoting]] companies’ stocks.
* '''insolvency register''' — contains information on companies who entered [[insolvency]], [[bankruptcy]], [[liquidation]], [[administration (law)|administration]], [[receivership]], [[debt restructuring]], or have been under futile execution, either of an administrative debt (by a government agency) or of a [[private debt]] (by a bailiff), for longer than an amount of time specified by law, as well as on their liabilities.
* '''register or a list of a specified type of [[regulated market|regulated entities or activities]]''' — contains entries on companies officially authorized to perform a specified type of business, where prior obtaining of a permit, a license, a concession, or registration on such a list or register is a prerequisite required by law. Depending on situation, regulation may apply to an entity type, or to a type of entity's activity.__NOTOC__

== European Union and the European Economic Area ==
* '''[[company register]]s'''
** [[European Commission]] - the '''Business Registers Interconnection System (BRIS)'''  (uses data from national registers operated by the member states)<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://e-justice.europa.eu/content_find_a_company-489-en.do|title=European e-Justice Portal - Business registers – search for a company in the EU|website=e-justice.europa.eu}}</ref> (searchable); '''List of [[European Research Infrastructure Consortium|European Research Infrastructure Consortia]]'''<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ec.europa.eu/info/research-and-innovation/strategy/strategy-2020-2024/our-digital-future/european-research-infrastructures/eric/eric-landscape_en|title=ERIC Landscape |website=ec.europa.eu}}</ref> (online web list)
** [[European Committee of the Regions]] - '''Register of [[European grouping of territorial cooperation|European Groupings of Territorial Cooperation]]''' (uses data from national lists operated by the member states)<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://portal.cor.europa.eu/egtc/CoRActivities/Pages/egtc-map.aspx|title=CoR - Map & Register|website=portal.cor.europa.eu |date=19 November 2024 }}</ref> (available unrestricted as a search engine and a GIS/cadaster)
** the Authority for European Political Parties and European Political Foundations - '''Register of [[European political party|European political parties]] and [[European political foundation]]s''' (EU only)<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.appf.europa.eu/appf/en/parties-and-foundations/registered-parties|title=Registered Parties &#124; Parties and Foundations &#124; Authority for European Political Parties andEuropean Political Foundations|website=www.appf.europa.eu}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.appf.europa.eu/appf/en/parties-and-foundations/registered-foundations|title=Registered Foundations &#124; Parties and Foundations &#124; Authority for European Political Parties andEuropean Political Foundations|website=www.appf.europa.eu}}</ref> (online web lists)
* tax registers ([[European Commission]])
** '''[[VAT Information Exchange System]]''' (uses data from national registers operated by the member states) - taxpayers who obtained registration allowing to perform intra-community supply transactions; not mandatory for VAT-exempt entities involved in intra-community supply transactions of low worth in the given year, unless they do not perform services by delegating their employees to another EU country (online VAT number check)
** '''System of Exchange of Excise Data (SEED)''' (uses data from national lists operated by the member states) - {{in lang|en}}<ref name="Excise Authorisation Verification">{{cite web|url=https://ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/dds2/seed/seed_consultation.jsp?Lang=en|title=Excise Authorisation Verification|website=ec.europa.eu |language=en|access-date=20 February 2021}}</ref> (SEED number check)
** '''Registered Exporter System''' ('''REX''') (central register with input operated by the member states) {{in lang|en}}<ref name="REX number validation">{{cite web|url= https://ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/dds2/eos/rex_validation.jsp?Lang=en|title=REX number validation|website=ec.europa.eu|language=en|access-date=20 February 2021}}</ref> (REX number check)
** '''Economic Operator Identification and Registration System''' ('''EORI''') (central register with input operated by the member states) – {{in lang|en}}<ref name="EORI number validation">{{cite web|url= https://ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/dds2/eos/eori_validation.jsp?Lang=en|title=EORI number validation|language=en|access-date=20 February 2021|website=ec.europa.eu}}</ref> (EORI number check)
** '''Economic Operator Systems Authorized Economic Operator''' (central register with input operated by the member states) – Authorized Economic Operator Database {{in lang|en}}<ref name="ec.europa.eu">{{cite web|url= https://ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/dds2/eos/aeo_consultation.jsp?Lang=en|title=Authorised Economic Operators – Query page|website=ec.europa.eu|language=en|access-date=20 February 2021}}</ref> (searchable)
*vehicle registers
** '''EU Fleet Register''' (EU only, uses data from national lists operated by the member states) - registry of maritime commercial vessels used in [[fisheries]] within the [[Common Fisheries Policy]] {{in lang|en}}<ref name="Fleet Register">{{cite web|url=https://webgate.ec.europa.eu/fleet-europa/search_en|title=Fleet Register|website=webgate.ec.europa.eu|language=en|access-date=25 February 2021}}</ref> (searchable)

Foreign individuals and foreign companies have equal rights to register their companies, just like local individuals and local companies in Azerbaijan.

=== Poland ===
==== Regular company registers ====
There are two registers of entities which are obligated or allowed to register as entrepreneurs:
* [[Ministry of Development (Poland)|Ministry of Development]] (MR) – '''Central Registration and Information on Business''' ('''CEIDG''')'''<ref>{{cite web|url=https://prod.ceidg.gov.pl/CEIDG/CEIDG.Public.UI/Search.aspx|title=CEIDG – Przed wypełnieniem wniosku, wniosek o zawieszenie działalności gospodarczej, własna działalność, własna firma|website=prod.ceidg.gov.pl|language=en|access-date=6 July 2018}}</ref>''' – [[company register]] for natural persons trading as [[sole trader]]s or their civil law partnerships (searchable); such companies are prohibited from performing certain activities (e.g. operating a life insurance company), and proper agricultural activity ([[animal breeding]], [[plant cultivation]]) of an individual farmer is also excluded from registration in CEIDG; the register does not assign its own registration number, using the NIP (see below) for this purpose instead
* [[Ministry of Justice (Poland)|Ministry of Justice]] (MS): 
**'''National Court Register''' ('''KRS''')  {{in lang|pl}}<ref>{{cite web|url=https://ems.ms.gov.pl/krs/wyszukiwaniepodmiotu|title=E-MS-Portal {{!}} Strona główna|website=ems.ms.gov.pl|access-date=6 July 2018}}</ref> (searchable){{further|List of legal entity types by country#Entities registered in the National Court Register (Krajowy Rejestr Sądowy, KRS)}}  — register of the majority of juridical persons types, a well as other collective (private) legal entities (there are, however, numerous exceptions, see [[List of official business registers#Registers of businesses excluded from registration as entrepreneurs]]); assigns a registration number (numer KRS), mandatory to be exposed on all outbound company documents and letters; some activities (e.g. operating a school) are not available to all entities registered in KRS, but only to those who are juridical persons; members of some professions are not allowed to practise in all of the company types (e.g. an advocate is prohibited from practising the profession in the form of a limited liability company); its constituent parts are:
*** '''Register of Entrepreneurs''' (''Rejestr przedsiębiorców'') — the [[company register]] for entities other than natural persons which hold an  obligatory status of entrepreneurs: trade partnerships: either entities with legal capacity but lacking juridical personality (registered partnerships, limited partnerships, limited joint-stock partnerships, professional partnerships), or juridical persons (limited liability companies, joint-stock companies), as well as for other types of entrepreneurs who are juridical persons, as well as any of the juridical persons registered in the Register of Associations, Other Social and Professional Organizations, Foundations and Independent Public Healthcare Institutions (see below) if they intend to perform business activities (when allowed by their bylaws, excluding the stand-alone public healthcare institutions, as they are not allowed to register as an entrepreneur, as well as those of juridical persons or other legal entities who are registered in the KRS exclusively for the purpose of obtaining status of an officially recognized charity - public benefit organization, and would otherwise be excluded from the registration in the KRS - see below) 
*** '''Register of Associations, Other Social and Professional Organizations, Foundations and Stand-alone Public Healthcare Institutions''' (''Rejestr stowarzyszeń, innych organizacji społecznych i zawodowych, fundacji oraz samodzielnych publicznych zakładów opieki zdrowotnej'') — the other part of the KRS, is responsible for the registration of various other types of juridical persons. If any of the registered entities intend to perform business activities (when allowed by its bylaws), it also has to obtain registration in the Register of Entrepreneurs; in addition, juridical persons or any other legal entities (including those otherwise excluded or exempt from the registration in the KRS – see below) also have to register, if they apply for the status of an officially recognized charity (public benefit organization); however, as an exception, registration solely for that purpose neither confers juridical personality to entities lacking one nor does it create an obligation or right to register as an entrepreneur;
** '''Court and Commercial Gazette''' (''Monitor Sądowy i Gospodarczy'') – official gazette {{in lang|pl}}<ref>{{cite web|url= https://ems.ms.gov.pl/msig/przegladaniemonitorow|title=Monitor Sądowy i Gospodarczy|website=ems.ms.gov.pl|language=pl|access-date=6 July 2018}}</ref> (searchable);
** '''Financial document viewer''' (''Przeglądarka dokumentów finansowych'') {{in lang|pl}}<ref>{{Cite web |title=Przeglądanie dokumentów finansowych |url=https://ekrs.ms.gov.pl/rdf/pd/search_df |access-date=2022-10-17 |website=ekrs.ms.gov.pl}}</ref> - the official free viewer of financial documents that allows downloading financial documents of an entity entered in the Register of Entrepreneurs of the National Court Register, in particular financial statements, reports on activities, resolutions on the allocation of profit or coverage of losses. The KRS number of the entity is needed to search.
